crossRefs.note: “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them back; for I have…
The chieftains of Judah will say in their heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in Yahweh of Armies…
Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
They will say of me, ‘There is righteousness and strength only in Yahweh.’ ” Even to him will men come. All those who…
Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.
He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife…
House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of Yahweh.
Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods; but we will walk in the name of Yahweh our God forever and…
As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,
Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and…
If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and don’t tell the truth.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ…

translations.web: I will strengthen them in Yahweh; and they will walk up and down in his name,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: I will strengthen them in the LORD, and in His name they will walk,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: And I will strengthen them in the LORD; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: And I will strengthen them in Jehovah; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith Jehovah.
